 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 4 03-02-2026 Heard the parties.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the following relief/s:
(i) for issuance of appropriate writ, order/orders directing the respondents to get free the petitioner's lands bearing Old Khata No. 51 and Old R.5. plot No. 15 now new khata no. 81 R.s. Plot No. 25 measuring an area one Bigha situated at village Basochak, Thana No. 476 Anchal Warisaliganj within district Nawada whereby the respondents have encroached the said land for Construction of electricity Grid without initiating any proceeding under land Patna High Court CWJC No.17878 of 2017(4) dt.03-02-2026 acquisition Act or without giving any Compensation of the said land and without giving any opportunity to the petitioner directly respondents came with police force and bounded the land through iron wires and started construction works over the said land for the said Electric/grid.

3. The stand of both the State of Bihar as also the Bihar State Power Transmission Company Ltd.
